summary.plain: A large detector built around four gas-filled tracking chambers, two of them inside superconducting magnets, plus time-of-flight walls and a calorimeter that measures the spectators of each collision, inherited largely from NA49.
summary.technical: NA61/SHINE: four Time Projection Chambers (two Vertex TPCs inside superconducting magnets with combined bending power up to 9 Tm, two Main TPCs), time-of-flight walls and the Projectile Spectator Detector calorimeter, with beam position detectors and trigger counters, on the H2 beam line.

technology.quote: Numerous components of the NA61/SHINE set-up were inherited from its predecessors, in particular, the last one, the NA49 experiment.
technology.value: Large-acceptance spectrometer of four Time Projection Chambers in superconducting magnets with time-of-flight walls and a projectile spectator calorimeter
